text:
BC Place mepere na 19 June 1983 dị ka ụlọ egwuregwu dome kachasị ukwu n’ụwa nke a na-eji ikuku akwado, nke okpu akwa na-eku mmiri kpuchiri nke ghọrọ otu n’ime ihe nnọchianya nke Vancouver. Ọ bụ Studio Phillips Barratt haziri ya, e wukwara ya na ego mbụ nke CA$126.1 nde — ihe dị ka CA$356 nde na ego 2025. Ọ bụ Province of British Columbia nwere ya ma BC Pavilion Corporation (PavCo) na-elekọta ya, e chepụtara ebe ahụ ka ọ bụrụ ebe obibi maka nnukwu egwuregwu na ihe omume obodo nke obodo ahụ.

Site na mmalite ọ bụ ebe obibi nke BC Lions nke CFL, ọrụ nke malitere kemgbe 1983. Njirimara ya gbasaa n’ime afọ iri: BC Place ghọrọ ụlọ egwuregwu bụ isi maka 2010 Winter Olympic na Paralympic Games, na-anabata emume mmeghe na mmechi, ma ọ ka bụ ebe obibi nke Canada Sevens rugby na BC Sports Hall of Fame.

A gbanwere ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ site na ihe dị ka ọnwa 16, ihe dị ka CA$514 nde nke e mechara na 2011. Stantec Architecture haziri ya, ọrụ ahụ dochie okpu dome mbụ nke a na-eku mmiri site na okpu na-adọta nke eriri — nke kachasị ukwu n’ụwa — na-eme ka ebe ahụ dị ọhụrụ ma chekwaa ọnọdụ ya n’etiti obodo. N’otu afọ ahụ, Vancouver Whitecaps FC bịara dị ka onye nwe ebe, sonye na MLS na 2011 ma mee BC Place ebe obibi ya.

N’etiti ihe ndị pụrụ iche ya, BC Place nwere bọọdụ akara nke abụọ kachasị ukwu na North America nke a kpọgidere n’etiti, na-esote naanị AT&T Stadium. Ogige bọọlụ ya dị 117 site na 75 yards (107 site na 69 m), na-ezube inweta asambodo FIFA 2-star. Site na ụlọ egwuregwu dome na-eku mmiri ruo n’akara okpu na-adọta n’ụsọ oké osimiri Pacific nke Canada, BC Place na-emegharị onwe ya mgbe niile ma na-anọgide bụrụ otu n’ime ụlọ egwuregwu a ma ama na mba ahụ.
